Table 2 presents the incidence of IPC crime under the important-heads during the years 1966 to 1971 along with the percentage variations over the previous quinquennial average of 1966 to 1970 and over 1970. Compared to the quin-quennial average of 1966 to 1970 there had been increases under all the important heads except in the case of Criminal Breach of Trust, Cheating and Counterfeiting. The highest in-crease was noticed under dacoity (67.8%) followed by Robbery (64.6%) while the incidence under Counterfeiting showed a marked decrease of 34.3%. The incidence of Murder, Dacoity and Robbery during 1971 over 1970 indicated increases, the increase being 3.0%, 13.8% and 8.5% respectively, while all the other heads showed decreases, the marked decrease having been noticed under Criminal Breach of Trust (10.6%).
